svg_doodles.instructions: All decorative images must be created using inline SVG. DO NOT use external image URLs.

elements.star: Use sharp 4-point or 5-point stars with thick black stroke and bright fill.
elements.plus: Thick black crossed lines forming a plus sign.
elements.arrow: Hand-drawn style arrow with heavy black path, jagged edges, no anti-aliasing feel.
elements.blob: Organic shape with `border-4 border-black` applied to a `<path>` or rendered via CSS border-radius.
elements.paper_plane: Origami-style paper plane with thick black strokes and yellow/blue accents.
elements.spring: Spiral SVG with stroke-width: 4; stroke: black; fill: none;

framer_motion.hero_papers: Staggered upward exit with rotations. Initial: {y: 100, opacity: 0}, Animate: {y: 0, opacity: 1}, Transition: type: spring, bounce: 0.5. Then float endlessly.
framer_motion.timeline_scroll: Use useScroll and useTransform for horizontal progress mapping.

sections_layout.name: Navbar
sections_layout.layout: Fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#FFF9EF] border-b-4 border-black px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center. Links should be bold uppercase. Right side: Github chip + Get Started CTA.

sections_layout.name: Hero
sections_layout.layout: Min-h-screen pt-32 pb-16 px-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center relative overflow-hidden. Massive Bricolage H1 ('Stop Checking Papers. Start Understanding Learning.'). Floating SVG starbursts and paper planes. Trust badges styled as floating pill chips.
sections_layout.animation: Papers flying upward and transforming into 'AI Insight' cards. Teacher illustration via SVG/CSS shapes.

sections_layout.name: Problem Section
sections_layout.layout: Row of 4 cards, background colors: Pink, Mint, Blue, Orange. Connected by animated SVG arrows pointing right. Overflow-x-auto on mobile, grid-cols-4 on desktop.

sections_layout.name: Features Grid
sections_layout.layout: Bento-style grid. 8 items total (Paper Upload, AI Eval, Dashboards, Gaps, Chapters, Skills, Planner, Class Insights). Span variations (col-span-1, col-span-2). Cards should have high-contrast pastel backgrounds with brutalist card style. Icons should be massive and chunky.

sections_layout.name: How It Works Timeline
sections_layout.layout: Horizontal scroll section or stacked cards with thick vertical connecting line. 5 numbered steps. Numbers should be inside huge black circles.

sections_layout.name: Fake Dashboard Showcase
sections_layout.layout: Massive container with browser chrome (dots for buttons on top left). Inside: Mock UI built with CSS/SVG. Shows 'Concept Mastery' radial charts, 'Student Performance' bar charts (thick black borders).

sections_layout.name: Weekly Planner (Sticky Notes)
sections_layout.layout: Grid of 5-7 cards (Mon-Sun). Each rotated slightly (-3deg, 2deg, etc.) to look like actual post-it notes. Different bright colors. Thick borders.

sections_layout.name: AI Analysis Split
sections_layout.layout: 2-column layout. Left: Mockup of a handwritten test paper (lined background). Right: Floating 'Insight Bubbles' extracting Subject, Bloom's Taxonomy, Confidence Score.

sections_layout.name: Comparison Table
sections_layout.layout: 2-column table. 'Traditional LMS' vs 'Hermes AI'. Use brutalist table borders (border-collapse, thick black lines). 'Hermes' column highlighted in bright mint or yellow.

sections_layout.name: Stats
sections_layout.layout: 4 columns. Massive numbers (text-7xl+) in Archivo/Bricolage with text-stroke or solid shadow. (10K+ papers, 95% accuracy, 8x productivity, 4x faster)

sections_layout.name: Testimonials
sections_layout.layout: Comic-book style. Speech bubble containers (use custom clip-path or simple border-radius with an absolute positioned triangle tail). Avatar doodles.

sections_layout.name: FAQ
sections_layout.layout: Max-w-3xl mx-auto. Accordions using the neo-brutalism tokens. Thick borders, bright background on active.

sections_layout.name: Final CTA
sections_layout.layout: Huge padding (py-32). bg-[#FFD84D]. Border-y-4 border-black. Massive CTA button in center.

sections_layout.name: Footer
sections_layout.layout: bg-black text-white. Grid layout. Thick white borders if any borders used. Giant typography for 'HERMES'.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text on bright colors uses `#000000` to pass APCA/WCAG ratios.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, and accordion triggers MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: IMPORT FONTS: You must import 'Bricolage Grotesque' and 'DM Sans' from Google Fonts into index.css.
ABSOLUTELY NO AI SLOP. Avoid soft shadows, generic gradients, or glowing neon effects.
This is NEO-BRUTALISM. Everything must have a heavy `border-4 border-black`.
DO NOT center align large blocks of text; only center align headlines in the hero if necessary. Left-align body content for reading flow.
DO NOT use `transparent` backgrounds over complex layers. Always use solid colors like `#FFFFFF`, `#FFF9EF`, or bright brand colors.
All drop shadows must be SOLID, meaning `0px` blur radius (e.g., `shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]`). NEVER use `shadow-lg` which introduces blur.
All interactive elements (buttons, cards) must have micro-interactions: physical presses (translation) and shadow reduction on click.
DO NOT USE IMAGES. Build all illustrations, patterns, floating elements, and avatars using raw SVG paths and CSS.
Use Shadcn UI structurally where needed (like Accordion or Tabs), but strip their default borders/shadows and replace them with Neo-Brutalist utility classes.
Ensure generous padding (`p-6` to `p-12`) inside bordered containers so text doesn't touch the thick borders.
